notes: IMDPot is the single application contract: a 15-minute $IMD-only jackpot (minimum ticket 0.1 IMD, timer starts on the first ticket of a round, no deposit means no round). Its constructor takes one argument, owner_, filled by $owner (Ownable2Step owner; the factory as msg.sender is never an owner). It makes no external call, so it deploys on an empty chain. Fixed values from the brief are constants in the source, not constructor arguments: treasury 0x0b176115c1Bd31a782133100d3aaA6BE2b16F118 receives 5%, burn address 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD receives 10%, 15% is locked forever in the contract (totalLocked only increases; no owner or user function can move it), and 70% is claimable by the top 3 winners as 40/20/10% (fewer than 3 players rolls unfilled slots up to first place). finalizeRound() is permissionless after endTime and requests a Chainlink VRF v2.5 random word; the coordinator callback settles the round atomically (winners, fee pushes, lock, loyalty points, next round opened). Loyalty points are a non-transferable mapping, one point per ticket in finalized rounds; after 10 finalized rounds redeemMultiplier burns 100 points for +25% selection weight on the next round, capped at +100%. Security: ReentrancyGuard on all token-moving and round-mutating functions, Pausable (pause blocks buyTickets/finalizeRound/retryRandomness but never claim/refund/cancelRound), fee-on-transfer protection via balance deltas, pull-based prizes, non-reverting fee pushes with flushPendingFees fallback, Fenwick-tree weighted selection without replacement so settlement gas is independent of participant count. Post-launch owner configuration (no initialization call in this manifest): setToken(imd) once with the $IMD ERC-20 on Ethereum mainnet, then setVrfConfig(coordinator, subscriptionId, keyHash, callbackGasLimit, requestConfirmations, nativePayment) with the Chainlink VRF v2.5 mainnet coordinator and a funded subscription that lists IMDPot as a consumer; tickets are refused until both are set. VRF config can only change while the current round has no tickets. Emergency escape: if randomness has not arrived 24 hours after a round ended, anyone may cancelRound() and players refund 1:1. Owner powers are limited to configuration, pause and rescuing foreign (non-$IMD) tokens.
